caveats: The synthetic demo PROVES the technique works byte-exact when the organism is deterministic
The canonical projection is THE encoded size IF the AtomSmasher organism becomes deterministic AND the decoder runs it on the inputs to regenerate the derived receipts byte-exact

To convert the canonical projection from UNVERIFIED to VERIFIED, we need: (1) det-timestamps in the organism (2) audit and remove other non-determinism (3) build a replay function (4) verify replay output matches canonical byte-exact
